title: Story premise EDU080: The Night Map Gains a Dimmer
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (environment/ecology). Hook: Where does the light go after it misses the path? Takeaway/theme: Lighting design can consider direction, timing, purpose, and effects beyond the intended area.
description: A town wants useful nighttime lighting, but a plan treating every lit area alike hides where light travels beyond its intended target. Comparing shielded and unshielded symbolic beams frames a reviewed discussion of tradeoffs.
